newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian MinFins ease, dip further on IMF talks.
newsitem.headline: Russian MinFins ease, dip further on IMF talks.

text.p: Prices of Russian MinFin bonds eased on Friday in shaky trading on Friday, depressed further by news that talks between Russia and the International Monetary Fund were facing difficulties, dealers said.
Sources close to the talks said on Thursday discussions between Russia and the IMF are difficult and the two sides plan to issue a statement on Thursday or Friday. The IMF declined to comment.
Trading started from higher levels in Moscow but later, London and New York operators pushed prices down, dealers said.
"After news about the talks, somebody tried to hit prices, but they (prices) eased not more than 0.5 point from early levels," an International Moscow Bank dealer said.
"Trading is based on the news, which is not too good at the moment...Operators prefer to sell now or even open short positions," he added.
Dealers said the impact of the news was not large, with prices currently stable at new levels but with broader spreads.
"(The impact) would be really negative if they decide something. Any official can say anything, and I do not really care about it unless the IMF says something," a London bank dealer said.
